snippet.description:
Three attempts. One study table. And a completely different reality.

What starts with fresh notebooks, new pens and a perfectly planned study space can slowly turn into piles of books, unfinished plans and mental clutter.

As attempts increase, the pressure isn’t always visible in your preparation. Sometimes, it starts showing up on your desk, in your habits and in your mind.

This video explores the side of UPSC preparation that we don’t talk about enough: mental clarity, pressure and managing the journey beyond books and strategy.

Join Winning the Mind Game — Free Mental Health Workshop with Sonali Medhekar-Sheth, UPSC Mindset Coach.

Registration is FREE.
👉 Register Here: https://shorturl.at/ubGhU

Part 1: 20th September 2026 | 10 AM–1 PM | Online
Part 2: 27th September 2026 | 10 AM–1 PM | Online

📞 For queries: 8826496658

Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/6brt5mwLSFhENRCq8
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
